models_evaluated: six contemporary LLMs (not named in abstract)

links.outcome: LLM factual knowledge probe accuracy versus clinical trial reasoning task accuracy
links.effect: Mean GKMRV knowledge-probe accuracy was 0.918 while mean accuracy on main reasoning tasks was 0.25; output consistency across samples averaged 0.87.
links.quote: Models achieve near-ceiling GKMRV accuracy (mean accuracy 0.918) yet perform poorly on the main reasoning tasks (mean accuracy 0.25).

unlisted_practices: Separating knowledge-access probes from reasoning tasks to dissociate factual recall failures from inference failures in LLM evaluation

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation of LLMs on a clinical trial natural language inference task assessing factual knowledge versus reasoning limitations.
